newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan bank injects 330 mln dirhams at auction.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan bank injects 330 mln dirhams at auction.

text.p: The Moroccan Bank al-Maghrib (central bank) injected 330 million dirhams in the money market for one week at its repurchase auction on Wednesday, a bank official said.
The bank said it received bids totalling 4.615 billion dirhams and allocated 2.300 billion dirhams at a seven percent interest rate for one week.
The bank satisfied 49.84 percent of the demand for liquidity.
The next auction is due on October 16, 1996
